they ſpake to the people : † Theſe men are men of peace,
and are willing to dwel with vs: let them occupie in the land,
and til it, which being large and wide doth lacke men to tille
it : their daughters we ſbal take to wife, and ours we wil

a good is differred : If we circumciſe our men ſexe, folowing
23 the rite of the nation. † And their ſubſtance, and cattle,
and al things that they poſſeſſe, ſhal be ours: only in this ler
vs condeſcend, and dwelling togeather, we ſkal make one
people. †. And they al aſſented, and circumciſed al the man
ſex. † And behold the third dav, when the griefe of the
woundes is moſt paineful : Iacobs two ſonnes, Simeon and
Leui the brothers of Dina, taking their ſwordes, entred into
the citie boldly: and killing al the man ſex, † murdred withal
Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their ſiſter out of
Sichems houſe. † When they were gone forth, the other
ſonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were ſhaine : and
ſpoiled the citie in reuenge of the rape. † And waſting al
